profile.reading: T5 Data Centers has operated since 2008 per its own site. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This specific row was originally recorded in this registry under the operator T5 Data Centers, based on its own facility name, T5 Data Center, in Alpharetta, Georgia. A facility specific aggregator page on baxtel.com, fetched fresh this session while researching this rows address, surfaced a significant ownership update not reflected in this rows prior operator level research: Stack Infrastructure acquired this Alpharetta facility from T5 in 2019, per that pages own text, which states the facility was constructed in 2012 after the Fulton County Development Authority issued 160 million dollars in taxable bonds, and that T5 Data Centers established its first metro Atlanta facility at this Alpharetta site in 2011. This is consistent with, and specifically narrower than, this registrys separate prior finding that T5 was named alongside Infomart Data Centers as one of two asset sources IPI Partners drew on when forming STACK Infrastructure in 2019: that earlier finding concerned company level asset sourcing, while this new source confirms the specific building level transaction for this exact facility. No STACK Infrastructure row for an Alpharetta or metro Atlanta facility already exists elsewhere in this registry, so rather than flag a possible duplicate, this session corrected this rows own operator field directly from T5 Data Centers to Stack Infrastructure, the current operator per this new source, while preserving T5 Data Centers as former_operator per this registrys no-deletion policy, with ownership_verified_on set to the date of this research. The same baxtel.com page also gives 3200 Webb Bridge Road as the street address, which this session applied given it comes from the same page confirming the ownership change and building history.

profile.reading:
STACK Infrastructure launched on January 16, 2019, when IPI Partners, a joint venture between Iron Point and Iconiq Capital, combined the assets of Infomart Data Centers and T5 Data Centers into a single wholesale colocation platform. The company is commonly reported as headquartered in Denver, Colorado, though this entry did not independently confirm that address against a primary source this session.

STACKs own site describes a global footprint of 22 locations across three regions, 10 in the Americas, 7 in EMEA, and 5 in Asia Pacific, without stating a founding year, headquarters address, or aggregate capacity figure on the fetched page itself.

The registry here tracks 11 STACK facilities across four states, California, Illinois, Oregon, and Virginia, a subset of its ten Americas locations. As with CyrusOne, QTS, and DataBank elsewhere in this registry, STACKs formation by combining two predecessor operators, Infomart and T5, under new private-equity ownership is a pattern worth checking against this registrys facility-level data: any STACK facility with legacy Infomart or T5 branding should be recorded with a former_operator note rather than treated as a STACK-only history. This specific facility, recorded in this registry as STACK New Albany in Franklin County, OH, was not individually named in the operator-level research above; its operator field was blank in the source data and is corrected here to Stack Infrastructure based on the facility own name, which unambiguously identifies its operator brand. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
profile.research_note: Operator field corrected from blank to Stack Infrastructure based on the facility own name (source data left operator blank). Reused operator-level research from twoai_dc_operators row: Stack Infrastructure.
